releaseScope: Maintenance repair round M-P3 (D-83, definition recovered from the 3.1.0 baseline via the qoder evidence mirror): output.schema.json no longer pins report.version to a hardcoded const (0.6.0 in 0.6.2) - the report names the linter release that produced it. workflow.yaml self-version in lockstep.
openDeferred: Publication is not adoption: no current pointer, platform configuration or platform default is changed by this release (BP-2, red line 5).

The measured context ceiling of each platform is not proven by this release; windowProfile is read from the Agent manifest and defaults to 256k, and the qoder platform attestation is recorded separately in qoder/bridge/capabilities.json.
The token figure is a declared formula (1.1 per CJK character, 1 per 3.6 other characters), not a claim about any model's real tokenizer; no tokenizer is installed on this host.
